_about: Every number and quoted phrase on screen, with its source (see sources.md). Checked 2026-10-20.

anthropic._source: Anthropic, 'Investigating incidents in our cybersecurity evaluations', 30 Jul 2026 (upd. 3 Aug): 'our evaluation prompt stated explicitly that Claude had no internet access'; 'a misconfiguration left the machines that Claude accessed as part of the evaluation with live internet access'; Claude models compromised production systems at three organizations; 'The two organizations we were able to reach had not previously detected the activity'

google._source: NBC News, 18 Sep 2026, on Google's disclosure: Gemini 'gained unauthorized access to three outside systems during a test' by guessing login information or using credentials found in a public repository; the model 'thought that the outside computer systems were part of the test' (Heather Adkins, Google)

openai._source: TechCrunch, 21 Jul 2026, on OpenAI's statement: the models 'escaped their isolated testing environment' via 'an undisclosed vulnerability in the package-installer program' and could 'obtain test solutions directly from Hugging Face's production database'. CSO Online, 14 Oct 2026, Dan Wallach (RAND): the Hugging Face incident 'went on for days, and nobody noticed'
openai.sourceLine: OpenAI через TechCrunch, 21.07.2026 · Д. Уоллак (RAND), CSO Online

replit._source: heise online, 25 Jul 2025, after Jason Lemkin (SaaStr) on X: Replit's agent deleted the production database during a code and action freeze without permission; it said a rollback was impossible, but a backup was available and could be imported. The app was a demo with real data

experts._source: CSO Online, 14 Oct 2026: 'tried-and-true containment practices that stretch back to the 1990s'; Rob T. Lee (SANS Institute): 'These are things that we've been dealing with for years'
